description:

title: Business Development Associate
description:
**Business Development Associate**

**What does this team do?**

Responsible for driving enrolments into Marrow, our flagship learning platform for doctors, through field sales efforts. The role involves directly engaging with medical professionals to promote career\-advancing programs and specialized upskilling courses that build critical skills required for success in super\-specialty fields. It includes creating on\-ground awareness about Marrow’s offerings, particularly in areas not adequately covered in traditional medical education. The primary focus is on doctors who have completed MBBS and are preparing for NEET PG, guiding them toward the right resources to strengthen their preparation and excel in their chosen specialisation.

**What would you be doing here?**

* **Walk\-in visits:** Visit medical colleges within your assigned territory and interact with students.
* **Events \& activations:** Plan, manage, and execute college events, fests, and on\-ground activations end\-to\-end.
* **Marketing \& awareness:** Distribute marketing materials and create strong brand visibility for Marrow.
* **Lead generation:** Capture and build a high\-quality database of prospective users.
* **Lead management:** Follow up consistently and nurture leads through the funnel.
* **Lead conversion:** Pitch subscription plans, close deals, and achieve monthly revenue targets.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with your manager and cross\-functional teams to drive campaigns and hit business goals

**What are we looking for?**

* Graduate in any discipline (MBA is a plus)
* Experience in managing events, conferences, or on\-ground activations
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently
* Comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and large student groups
* (Preferred) Multilingual / comfortable in diverse environments
* Willingness to travel extensively and meet new people regularly
* Highly driven, confident, competitive, and a strong team player

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Pre-Sales Executive
description:
Job Description – Technical Pre\-Sales Executive

Technical Pre\-Sales Executive – Cybersecurity \& IT Infrastructure

Experience

Minimum 5 Years

Qualification

Graduate in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related technical discipline.

Preferred Background

Candidates from System Integrators (SI), OEMs, Cybersecurity Companies, IT Infrastructure Providers, or Technology Consulting organizations will be preferred.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically strong Pre\-Sales Executive who possesses deep understanding of Cybersecurity, IT Infrastructure, Networking, Cloud, and Enterprise Technologies.

The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding customer requirements, designing technical solutions, preparing technical proposals, conducting solution presentations, and supporting the sales team throughout the solutioning process.

The candidate must be customer\-facing, technically sound, and able to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand customer business and technical requirements and propose appropriate technology solutions.
* Work closely with the Sales team during customer engagements, presentations, and solution discussions.
* Prepare technical proposals, solution architectures, BoM/BoQ, compliance matrices, and technical documentation.
* Conduct technical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, and solution briefings.
* Participate in RFP/RFQ/RFI responses and tender submissions.
* Coordinate with OEMs, distributors, and technology partners for solution design and sizing.
* Assist customers in evaluating cybersecurity, cloud, networking, and infrastructure solutions.
* Support Proof of Concept (PoC), product evaluations, and technical discussions.
* Provide technical guidance during bid preparation and customer presentations.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, cybersecurity trends, AI solutions, cloud technologies, and enterprise infrastructure.

Technical Skills Required

Strong knowledge and hands\-on understanding of:

Cybersecurity

* Next Generation Firewalls (NGFW)
* Endpoint Security (EDR/XDR)
* Email Security
* SIEM \& SOC Solutions
* Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing (VA/PT)
* Identity \& Access Management (IAM)
* Privileged Access Management (PAM)
* Network Security and Security Architecture

IT Infrastructure

* Servers and Storage
* NAS/SAN Solutions
* Backup \& Disaster Recovery
* Virtualization Platforms
* Active Directory
* Data Center Technologies
* Networking and Switching

Cloud \& Emerging Technologies

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* Hybrid Cloud Solutions
* AI \& Generative AI Fundamentals
* Cloud Security Concepts

Required Skills

* Excellent technical understanding of cybersecurity and infrastructure solutions.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to engage with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, IT Heads, and technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in customer\-facing technical roles.
* Ability to independently handle technical discussions and requirement gathering sessions.
* Experience in preparing technical documentation, solution designs, and proposals.

Preferred Certifications

The following certifications will be an added advantage:

* Microsoft Azure Certifications
* AWS Certifications
* Fortinet NSE
* Palo Alto Certifications
* Cisco Certifications
* CEH
* CompTIA Security\+
* OEM\-specific cybersecurity certifications

Key Competencies

* Technical Solution Design
* Cybersecurity
* IT Infrastructure
* Cloud Technologies
* Customer Engagement
* Technical Presentations
* RFP/Tender Management
* Solution Architecture
* Requirement Gathering
* Stakeholder Management

Location

Delhi / NCR

Employment Type

Full\-Time

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**About Medigurukulam:**

Medigurukulam is a fast\-growing e\-learning platform dedicated to medical and paramedical students, offering comprehensive, curriculum\-based learning tools.

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a dynamic and goal\-oriented **Channel Sales Manager (CSM)** to drive revenue growth through **direct sales** and by **recruiting, training, and managing a network of Franchises**. The ideal candidate will be passionate about sales, have strong communication and leadership skills, and be comfortable working in a performance\-driven environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct field visits and campus outreach activities for promote Medigurukulam’s e\-learning products
* Recruit and onboard Franchises to promote the product
* Train Franchises on product features, sales techniques, and pitch strategies
* Drive daily/weekly sales targets in the assigned territory.
* Monitor Franchises activities and support them in converting leads to paying customers.
* Identify potential institutions and opportunities for partnership.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**

* 0–5 years of experience in sales, field marketing, or student outreach.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Self\-driven, with a passion for fieldwork and achieving sales targets.
* Ability to work independently and manage a team of DSAs.
* Freshers with strong leadership traits and a sales mindset are encouraged to apply.

**Compensation:**

· Salary Range\- 15 k – 30 k/ month

· Incentives

**With Us:** If you are interested in this opportunity, please feel free to connect with us at:

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Business Development Developer
description:
Business Development Manager (BDM) – FinTech

**Location:** Delhi, India  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Mode:** On\-site  
**Experience:** 8–10 years  
**Industry:** FinTech / RegTech / Digital Lending / BFSI

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Business Development Manager (BDM)** to drive enterprise sales and business growth in the **FinTech, RegTech, and Digital KYC** space.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **B2B/enterprise sales**, a good understanding of **API\-based SaaS products**, and an established network across **Banks, NBFCs, FinTech companies, and other BFSI organizations**.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to deal closure.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities in the BFSI and FinTech sectors.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Banks, NBFCs, FinTechs, and enterprise clients.
* Promote and sell Digital Identity and KYC solutions, including:
* eSign
* Video KYC
* OCR
* KYC/AML APIs
* PAN Verification API
* Aadhaar\-related services
* CKYC
* GST Verification API
* Bank Account Verification APIs
* Understand client requirements and coordinate with Product and Technology teams to provide suitable solutions.
* Prepare commercial proposals, quotations, presentations, and enterprise agreements.
* Conduct client meetings, product presentations, negotiations, and follow\-ups.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales and revenue targets.
* Maintain a strong sales pipeline and provide regular sales reports and forecasts.

Requirements

* 8–10 years of experience in **Business Development / Enterprise Sales**.
* Experience in **FinTech, RegTech, Digital Lending, KYC, Digital Identity, or BFSI** is preferred.
* Strong understanding of **API\-based SaaS products and enterprise sales**.
* Knowledge of **Digital Onboarding and RBI\-compliant Video KYC processes**.
* Proven experience in B2B sales and business development.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-management skills.
* Ability to understand technical products and explain solutions to business clients.
* Existing network with Banks, NBFCs, FinTechs, or BFSI organizations will be an added advantage.

Preferred Skills

**Business Development \| Enterprise Sales \| B2B Sales \| FinTech \| RegTech \| BFSI \| API Sales \| SaaS Sales \| KYC \| Video KYC \| Digital Identity \| eSign \| OCR \| Digital Lending**

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work in the growing FinTech and Digital Identity space.
* Exposure to enterprise clients across BFSI and FinTech.
* Growth\-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to work with Product, Technology, and Business teams.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:

**hr@nextbigbox.in**

Pay: ₹10,846\.54 \- ₹36,803\.25 per month

Work Location: In person
